title: CduFile
description:
`cdu.yaml`: page-by-page CDU walkthroughs, each with the text and live flight values the
screen shows at every step. A step's `opens` names one, and the app opens it from that step
in the slide-out, with the flight's values filled in.

CduField.description: A live flight value. Calculations happen in the app, never in the pack.

after.description: Literal text after the value, e.g. a degree sign.

before.description: Literal text before the value, e.g. `RW`.

empty.description: Shown when the value is not known.

field.description:
The flight field whose value is shown, which the pack must define. `route_leg` shows
one route row and needs `index` and `part`; `manual` is not allowed here.

form.description: How the value is written, when the CDU writes it differently from the Flight pages.

part.description: For `route_leg`: which half of the row.

style.description: The style the value is drawn in.

CduForm.description:
How a value is written on the CDU screen. The forms are the app's: they describe ways of
writing a value, not an aircraft. A value that doesn't read as its form shows as it is.

oneOf.description: A wind, `ddd/sss`, with a degree sign after the direction: `270°/045`.
A temperature in degrees Celsius, in Fahrenheit then Celsius: `-62°F -52°C`.

A temperature difference in degrees Celsius, signed, in Fahrenheit then Celsius:
`+4°F +2°C`.
A UTC time, `10:00`, as hours, minutes and tenths of a minute: `1000.0z`.
A date, `2025-11-13`, as month, day and year: `NOV13/25`.

Two dates, `2025-10-30/2025-11-27`, as month and day each, then the second's year:
`OCT30NOV27/25`.

CduInline.description: Text or a live value, in any style. Mix several in a row to style them differently.

CduPage.description: One step of a CDU walkthrough.

action.description: What to do on this page.

check.description: What to check once it is done.

note.description: A further note for this page.

page.description: The CDU page name, e.g. `PERF INIT`.

screen.description: What the CDU screen shows at this step.

CduRouteCount.description:
A number calculated from the route. The rows per page are the aircraft's, so they
come from the pack.

empty.description: Shown instead when the count is zero.

per_page.description: How many route rows one page holds; at least 1.

route_legs.description: Which count: the pages, or the rows past the first page.

style.description: The style the number is drawn in.

CduRow.description: One line select row: a small label line above a value line.

left.description: The value on the left, beside its line select key.

left_label.description: The small label above the left value.

right.description: The value on the right, beside its line select key.

right_label.description: The small label above the right value.

separator.description: Draws a divider instead of the labels; empty text means a plain line.

CduScreen.description: What the CDU shows on one walkthrough page.

highlight.description: Line select keys to highlight, e.g. `2L`.

page.description: The page count beside the title, e.g. `1/2`.

rows.description: The line select rows, top to bottom.

scratchpad.description: The scratchpad line below the rows.

title.description: The title line at the top of the screen.

CduStyle.description: How text appears on the CDU screen.

oneOf.description: System data the pilot does not enter.
Values the system has calculated or accepted.

style.description: The style it is drawn in.

CduWalkthrough.description: A page-by-page guide a step can open.

id.description: Unique in the pack; a step's `opens` names it.

CduWhen.description:
Shows one group of parts when flight values are known and another when they are not,
e.g. `<SEL>` beside a runway, or a placeholder until there is a runway. Does not nest.

otherwise.description: The parts shown when any of them is not; nothing when left out.

show.description: The parts shown when every field in `when_known` is known.

when_known.description: Every one of these must be known for `show` to appear.

FieldId.description:
A flight field's id, e.g. `zfw`: one of the fields the pack defines in `flight.yaml`
(decision 0029), or one of the app's own, [`FieldId::MANUAL`] and [`FieldId::ROUTE_LEG`].
Saved flights key their values by it, as text.

RouteLegCount.description: A count the app works out from the route.

oneOf.description: How many pages the route legs and departure need, at least 1.
How many route rows do not fit on the first page.

RouteLegPart.description: Which half of a route row a field shows.

oneOf.description: The left half: the way the leg is flown.
The right half: where the leg ends.
